title: Balanced complex computation of the base-tensor unit on cohomology
statement: Let R,A,Aq,B,D be commutative rings in one universe with the algebra and derived-category structures of def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model. Let Q be an A-module cochain complex, L a base-derived R-to-B tensor cohomology model for Q, K such a model for Aq tensor_A Q, and uQ the degreewise R-linear unit x -> 1 tensor x. Fix i in Z. There exist an A-module complex C, an A-linear cohomology isomorphism e from L.cohomology(i) restricted along A -> A tensor_R B to H^i(C), and an A-linear isomorphism e' from K.cohomology(i) restricted along A -> Aq -> Aq tensor_R B to H^i(restrict_A(Aq tensor_A C)), such that e' composed with localizationModelMap equals H^i of the scalar-extension unit of C composed with e. There is no localization or flatness assumption on Aq.

proof.text: Use RingTensorCohomology.flatResolution R, the proved source-library reduced functorial flat resolution, on B[0]. Its augmentation gives f and its kFlat_resolutionFunctor_obj theorem proves F is K-flat. Define C as the mixed total tensor of Q and F.
Obtain theta from the pure algebraic scalar-extension theorem, including its diagonal pure-tensor formula.

Obtain e and eq from the fixed balanced-model comparison. Let t be homology of restrict_A(theta) and set e_prime=eq followed by t inverse. homologyMap_comp rewrites the square as eq(map x)=t(H(unit_C)(e x)). Cancel t using hom_inv_id.

theorem exists_baseTensorUnitCohomologyModel (i : ℤ)
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
    (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R Aq B ((extend A Aq).obj Q) D)
    (uQ : (restrict R A).obj Q ⟶ (restrict R Aq).obj ((extend A Aq).obj Q))
    (huQ : ∀ (j : ℤ) (x : Q.X j), uQ.f j x = (1 : Aq) ⊗ₜ[A,algebraMap A Aq] x) :
    ∃ (C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
      (e : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := R) : A →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] B).toRingHom).obj
          (L.cohomology i) ≅ C.homology i)
      (e' : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := R) : Aq →ₐ[R] Aq ⊗[R] B).toRingHom.comp
          (algebraMap A Aq))).obj (K.cohomology i) ≅
          ((restrict A Aq).obj ((extend A Aq).obj C)).homology i),
      ∀ x : L.cohomology i,
        e'.hom (localizationModelMap R A Aq B D i Q L K uQ x) =
          (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj (algebraMap A Aq)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).unit.app C) i) (e.hom x)
